- Optional **Lorie X-server**.

It is recommended to _disable WoW64_ mode with **VirGL** for better performance.

**Changes:**

releases.name: ares v148
releases.body:
ares v148 has now been released.

This release includes big improvements to a number of ares cores. Highlights include rewrites to the N64 CPU & RSP JITs resulting in significant performance gains across the N64 library, additional implementation & accuracy improvements to the PlayStation core, fixes to the GBA core, and support for the Famicom data recorder & Dendy. 

Additionally, there have been many updates to the core ares application across all platforms. Per-core input configuration has been added, updated video, audio, & input drivers are available, bug fixes, additional options have been added, and core dependencies have been updated. 

Since v147, 20 contributors have created 300 commits to the ares codebase.

As always, if you wish to see the full changelog in a per-commit format along with their authors, you can do so on GitHub [here](https://github.com/ares-emulator/ares/compare/v147...v148).

Since v144, 8 contributors have created 90 commits to the ares codebase.

As always, if you wish to see the full changelog in a per-commit format along with their authors, you can do so on GitHub [here](https://github.com/ares-emulator/ares/compare/v144...v145).

- Implemented many undocumented instruction encodings
- Implemented invalid CPSR modes
- Added support for MRC, MCR, and CDP coprocessor instructions
- Allowed misalignment of the program counter in ARM mode

**Nintendo - Game Boy Color**

- Improved HDMA and GDMA timings (fixes some major graphical bugs)

**Nintendo - Game Boy Advance**

- Added support for the Real Time Clock
- Re-introduced optional Game Boy Player support

Def Jam v1.3 brings Discord account integration, room discovery corrections, voice chat, refreshed menus and restored custom analog controls to the Android ARM64 port.

## Online and Discord
- Sign in through the official FFNY Online Discord account service. New connections use the verified account name; the manual player-name screen is removed.
- Saved sessions use encrypted app-private storage. Account sign-out, deletion and privacy controls remain accessible inside the game.

- Added real account statistics and leaderboard access in the native online menu.

releases.name: xbased 1.2.14
releases.body:
## 1.2.14 (2026-11)

### Performance
- Scenes made of many small pieces run much faster. A game that draws lots
  of small triangle strips one after another has them drawn as one, and each
  draw uploads only the shader constants it uses. 007 Everything or
  Nothing's first level, looking at the courtyard, went from 38 to about 135
  fps uncapped on a fast PC, and at Original it now holds 30 where it
  dropped to 13 (#429).
- Interrupts reach the emulated CPU with a single memory write instead of a
  call into Windows, which made every game's interrupts cheaper.
- Uncapped games that show a frame every second vblank no longer wait on
  Windows' timer between the two, which can't wait less than half a
  millisecond.
- Unlocked on a 120 Hz or faster display (VRR or not): a frame that comes
  late is shown at once instead of waiting for the display's next refresh.

### Fixes
- Frame rate limit: Spyro A Hero's Tail ran at 64.5 fps at Up to 60. The
  limit followed a vsync grid that slowly moved back, and the display's
  refresh period could be measured as a fraction of the real one. Frames are
  now counted against the display's refreshes (#430).

releases.name: xbased 1.2.13
releases.body:
## 1.2.13 (2026-11)

A cleanup and optimization release: the same emulator, with less code.

### Changes
- The code is cleaned of everything that no longer served: the paths for
  platforms xbased doesn't run on, the workarounds for graphics drivers no PC
  has, old files, and functions nothing called any more. About 8,000 lines of
  code less, the executable a little smaller, and nothing that changes how
  games run.
- Depth buffers are created only with the uses they have, which leaves the
  driver more room to compress them.
- The debug switches (props.ini) are read by one piece of code on Windows and
  Linux alike.
- The source repository is tidier: README, BUILDING and CHANGELOG at its root,
  the build steps in one place, and every library built in listed with its
  license.

### Fixes
- The Linux build compiles without warnings on Ubuntu 22.04 (a few
  declarations its C library doesn't have).

### New
- Downsampling (Settings > Video > Downsampling: Off, 1x, 2x, 4x): the game

  the console's own resolution, or twice or four times it, before it's scaled
  to your screen. Smooth edges with the original look. It needs an internal
  resolution above the size chosen, and works with FXAA, FSR and the CRT look

- Fable The Lost Chapters: the hero's hair could turn into streaks up close

  and the other way round, and a state that is refused says why in the log.
- Frame rate limit: with the GPU maxed out (a high internal resolution on a
  laptop) the frame rate could drift above the limit, 64 fps at Up to 60 in
  Crash Bandicoot The Wrath of Cortex. The moments the presenter picks frames

releases.body:
## 1.2.11 (2026-11)

### Fixes
- Frame rate limit: games that keep three frames ready, like Crash Bandicoot
  The Wrath of Cortex, could go over the limit on a busy PC (64-65 fps at
  Up to 60 on a laptop). Right after a frame went through, a second one could
  be let through a millisecond later before the emulated GPU had moved on

- Games that flip in their own interrupt handler, like Star Wars Republic
  Commando, went about one frame a second over the limit (61 fps at Up to 60):
  a frame they flipped outside that handler didn't count against it.

### Fixes
- Glow and blur effects at higher resolutions: a game's blur passes, which
  sample a target at offsets of one pixel of the console's resolution, now

  into copies. Splinter Cell Pandora Tomorrow's goggles had a grid of green
  dots round them instead of a soft halo (#412, #421).
- SoulCalibur II after loading a state: the picture went softer and slower.
  A frame buffer taller than the screen came back from the state shorter than

  A, B, X, Y, Black and White are pressed at the amount set in the controller
  settings (50% by default), for games that read how hard the face buttons
  are pressed, like Metal Gear Solid 2 (#420).
- A trigger assigned to a face button presses it as far as the trigger goes,

releases.name: v0.1.13

## Endemic life is visible

Small creatures in the field (Stinkmink, Clothfly and the rest of the endemic life) were invisible in the port: you could still pick them up and get their buffs, but nothing was drawn. ## No more blinking objects after loading

While the game is running, each new combination of shader and render state needs a GPU pipeline. Pipelines the app has never seen are built in the background so the game doesn't freeze, and until one is ready the objects that use it are not drawn. Until now that also happened to pipelines it had already built in an earlier session. Only the first 4,000 were prepared at start-up, in the order they first appeared, so later in the game whole areas came from the background again. The result was objects and textures blinking for a few frames after loading a save or when walking into an area.

- Pipelines that the app has already built on your device are now created on the spot, in about a quarter of a millisecond each and within a small per-frame budget, so they are drawn from the first frame.
- Start-up preparation now begins with the pipelines your last session used (`pipelines_recientes.bin` in the game folder), not with the ones from the beginning of the game.
- Areas you visit for the very first time can still show an object a moment late while its pipeline is built. The second visit is clean.

# Model 3-Vulkan v0.9.9.8 — Release Notes

**2026-11-14 · Windows x64 · Linux x86_64 · macOS Intel**

Model 3-Vulkan v0.9.9.8 is a performance release. Nothing in the emulation model changed: every
game still renders the same picture it did in v0.9.9.6, and the same save states still load. What
changed is how much work the CPU and the GPU have to do to get there.

The headline is that the hybrid JIT now translates **more than 80 % of the guest instruction
stream to native x86-64**, the Vulkan renderer stopped paying for a redundant depth write that was
silently disabling hardware Early-Z / Hi-Z culling, and UMA GPUs finally get zero-copy geometry
upload. Together those turn the integrated-GPU experience from "lock it to 496×384" into a picture
that can actually be played at native resolution.

releases.name: v2.5.0
releases.body:
## Highlights

- **Disk images are kept unmodified with a save directory.** With `-saveDir`, what the software writes goes to an overlay file there and the image is only read. Overlays store only the tracks or blocks written and are tied to a checksum of their image. This also makes writable the disks that could not be written before: inside a zip or gzip, loaded from a URL, or embedded in the executable.
- **DOS 3.3 boots in five seconds.** The Disk II motor keeps turning for about a second after the drive is turned off, like the 556 timer of the real controller, and the data latch no longer reads the same nibble twice. DOS no longer waits for the motor on every access: a DOS 3.3 boot takes 5.4 million cycles instead of 36 million.
- **A libretro core** runs izapple2 inside RetroArch and the other libretro frontends, with diskette swapping from M3U playlists and saves as overlays. It is built from source and is not in the release archives. See [the libretro page](https://github.com/ivanizag/izapple2/blob/master/doc/frontend_libretro.md) and [the Mac guide](https://github.com/ivanizag/izapple2/blob/master/doc/frontend_libretro_macos.md).

**Headlight beams in both games, and the first Android beta.** At night your car finally lights up the road ahead and we're releasing the Android version for further testing.

## Features

- **Headlight beams.** Turning your lights on at night now throws a beam of light onto the road ahead, as on the original Xbox: it brightens the street, cars and walls it reaches and stops where it meets them ([#10](https://github.com/laureladastra/mcdub3-nx/issues/10), thanks for the report). Before, the lights worked in the game but no beam was drawn. Other emulators (i.e. xemu → https://github.com/xemu-project/xemu/issues/996) show a solid white shape instead. The game builds the beam in a small hidden picture using two tricks of the Xbox's graphics chip that the port did not reproduce yet: it reuses a picture as a depth map, and it counts the beam's layers with a special blending mode that works with negative numbers. Both are emulated now. Tested in the DUB Edition and the Remix. The WHITE button flashes your high beams while you hold it. The main headlights are on by themselves at night.

releases.name: mcdub3-nx v1.0.0
releases.body:
**Version 1.0 for both games on the Nintendo Switch.** This release removes the last annoyances: races that felt slow when the frame rate dipped, random zoom-in or out during loading screens, and vertical lines during upscaling.

### Features

- **Races keep their real speed.** The original game moves the race forward by a fixed step every frame, which was fine on the Xbox, where it runs on a fixed 30 FPS. On the Switch, in rain, with nitrous or in the busiest streets, the frame rate can dip and the whole race then went into slow motion. The race now proceeds by the time that really passed. Racing in the rain and with nitrous feels much steadier.
- **No more random zooms during loading screens.** Menus and loading screens are drawn for 4:3 TVs, with black strips at the sides, and the port enlarges them to fill your 16:9 screen. When something briefly reached those strips (the circle animation on loading screens for example), the picture behind it jumped in size for a brief moment. The size stays put now.

releases.name: mcdub3-nx v0.5.0
releases.body:
**A big speed update for both games on the Switch.** Races, especially in the rain, now run close to the game's own top speed of 30 FPS most of the time. Freezes during races are minimised.

- Measured in rain races on the Switch (at the default 1x picture size):

  |                                    | v0.4.0                 | v0.5.0   |
  | ---------------------------------- | ---------------------- | -------- |
  | Midnight Club 3: DUB Edition       | 23 frames per second   | **28.5** |
  | Midnight Club 3: DUB Edition Remix | 20.5 frames per second | **27.5** |

  The game itself never runs faster than 30, as on the original Xbox, so most of the time you are now at or near full speed.
- **No more half-second freezes in races.** The game stopped for about half a second now and then during a race, most often right after the start.
- **Sharper look for less effort (Remix).** The Remix's glow and blur effects are drawn at normal size even when you raise the picture size, which cost a lot of speed for something that is blurred anyway.

### Other changes

- Each game now has its own tuned graphics settings, so improving one game does not change the other.

First public Android release of Project Gotham Racing 4 (ARM64, Vulkan).

### Highlights
- **Standalone Launcher:** no PC or ADB needed — pick an extracted game folder (with \default.xex\) or a \.iso\ Xbox 360 disc image directly on your phone.
- **GPU Auto-Detection:** automatically configures fast 720p settings on Snapdragon (Adreno) and safe compatible defaults on Mali / Dimensity devices.
- **Driver Manager:** import custom Turnip \.zip\ drivers and test them in an isolated probe process before launching.
- **Graphics & Controls:** one-tap presets (*Performance 720p*, *Compatible*, *High Quality*), resolution scale, VSync, FPS/thermal overlay, and touch controls toggle/opacity for gamepads.

> **Note:** No game files are included. Provide your own legal dump of the base Xbox 360 disc (\4D5307F9\).

releases.body:
# Open Nectar 1.0.9.1 — Windows antivirus fix

### **Windows only.** 

Linux, macOS and Android stay on
[1.0.9](https://github.com/SSunnKing/Open-Nectar---Pikmin-Native-PC-Mobile-Port/releases/tag/1.0.9).
Download those from there. Nothing changes in the games themselves.

**Updating:** press **Update** in your launcher. Saves, settings and texture
packs carry over.

## Windows Defender flagged the launcher as a trojan

Some players got a "Threat found" warning from Windows Defender for
`nectar-launcher.exe` (`Trojan:Win32/Bearfoos.A!ml`). This was a false
positive. The `!ml` means it came from Defender's machine-learning guess,
not from a real malware match.

The launcher was doing things that look suspicious to an antivirus: it
started `curl.exe` and `tar.exe` in the background to download updates and
texture packs, and the exe had no publisher or version info. This release
changes that:

* Downloads now happen inside the launcher instead of through `curl.exe`.
* Update zips are unpacked inside the launcher instead of through `tar.exe`.
* `nectar.exe`, `nectar-pal.exe` and `nectar-launcher.exe` now have
  publisher and version information (right-click → Properties → Details).

releases.body:
Unreal Tournament 3 Android ARM64 port, version 0.5-dev (versionCode 9).

### Changes

- Added native implementations of selected game, rendering, AI and container algorithms, with the original recompiled paths retained. Optimized guest-register handling, x87 calculations and indirect-call caches.
- Added Optimal (ARM64) and Exact (x86) execution modes. Exact selects the original recompiled algorithms; both modes run as ARM64 code.
- Reduced GLES state traffic between threads, draw preparation work and shader constant uploads, and improved shader program caching.
- Improved launcher operation progress, diagnostics and Play button feedback, with the amber UT3 palette.
- Added an optional 4 GB guest address space, enabled by default on 64-bit devices with at least 5 GiB of RAM.
- Fixed fingerprint sensors being mistaken for gamepads.
- Reduced APK size by stripping non-runtime library symbols while retaining the original library for offline profiling. Expanded regression tests and updated documentation.

### Requirements

releases.body:
Unreal Tournament 3 Android ARM64 port, version 0.4.1-dev (versionCode 8).

### Changes

- Improved CPU performance on PhysX Mod Pack maps with native fluid collision kernels, native pair removal and optimized x87 calculations.
- Added on-device HLSL compilation through vkd3d-shader, with shader caching and improved MojoShader compatibility for mod materials.
- Fixed touch aiming: holding Fire no longer blocks another finger's camera movement; dragging from Fire, secondary fire, Jump or Crouch also turns the camera.
- Made the crash monitor a launcher option, disabled by default, to avoid keeping its extra Android process running unless needed.
- Removed FSR3 frame generation. FSR1 spatial upscaling and FXAA remain available.
- Reduced per-draw post-processing overhead and removed temporary qa-flags performance switches.
- Updated localized PhysX and audio setting descriptions.

### Installation and validation

Requires Android 11+ on ARM64 and your own files from the Steam version of the game. DXVK requires Vulkan 1.3; compatible Adreno devices can use Turnip.

Unreal Tournament 3 Android ARM64 port, version 0.4-dev.

### Changes

- Added an FPS counter with a frame-time graph and optional system information for every renderer.
- Added FSR1, FXAA, and FSR3.1 frame generation (DXVK, Android 12+; disabled by default).
- Added CPU-based PhysX effects and OpenAL Soft audio through AAudio with EAX 1–5 support.
- Added a maximum-graphics button and fixed persistence of the 3D rendering scale.
- Fixed terrain rendering in OpenGL ES, accelerated DXT decoding, and allowed unused texture mip levels to stream out.
- Improved GPU query handling in GLES and DXVK, including on PowerVR devices.
- Fixed ASTC/ETC2 texture conversion on shared storage on Pixel devices.
- Added a “Firing or aiming” gyroscope mode and persistent crash reports with a separate error window.

### Installation and limitations

Requires Android 11+ on ARM64 and your own files from the Steam version of the game. DXVK requires Vulkan 1.3; frame generation requires Android 12+. Frame generation may cause HUD artifacts and adds GPU and memory overhead. A stable 60 FPS at maximum graphics settings is not guaranteed.

releases.name: Unreal Tournament 3 Android ARM64 port 0.3-dev
releases.body:
The third release of the native Android ARM64 port of Unreal Tournament 3 improves GLES performance, text editing and graphics cache handling.

### Changes

- Added a dedicated GLES render thread with automatic CPU core selection. Streamed draw uploads, asynchronous query polling and shader program prelinking reduce work on the game thread.
- Added driver-aware graphics cache maintenance: GLES program binaries are invalidated after driver changes, and DXVK keeps the current and newest other pipeline cache for each driver.
- Fixed DXVK scaled vertex formats with a shader fallback for drivers that need it.
- Replaced keyboard-only text entry with an Android editing dialog for game fields, console commands and chat. Existing text can be corrected or cleared; cancellation preserves it, and original character filters remain in effect.
- Added separate weapon-button swipe settings and expanded the in-game Android settings to nine languages: English, Russian, Czech, German, Spanish, French, Hungarian, Italian and Polish.
- Improved launcher texture status and fixed texture handling, audio and FSINCOS translation. Expanded regression tests and rendering diagnostics.

### Requirements

- Added OpenSpy service and authentication compatibility, and fixed a registry-call crash during online play.
- Prevented startup defaults from overwriting saved profiles and campaign progress before sign-in. Fixed creation of save directories beneath virtual ZIP folders.

releases.body:
## P4GP 0.5.7

Versión estable pública de P4G-Android-Plus basada en Persona 4 Golden Android. Conserva el proyecto y el historial de su repositorio de origen, con identidad de aplicación independiente para instalarla junto a otros ports.

### Cambios incluidos desde el proyecto original

- Paquete Android independiente `io.github.synndras.p4gp`, nombre visible P4GP y recursos de marca propios.
- Launcher rediseñado con identidad visual Persona 4 Golden, fondo y recursos CRT, distribución panorámica adaptable y ajustes rápidos.
- Navegación del launcher por categorías con L1/R1; navegación de las opciones del submenú con el D-pad y gamepad.
- Categoría «Más opciones» para opciones adicionales y botón independiente de créditos.
- Créditos a nxdevxz, Brandon04Gonzalez, Chakeyy y synndras.
- Aviso en el launcher cuando se publica una actualización nueva.
- Menú de pausa nativo con estilo P4G, reanudar y salir, categorías de ajustes, controles táctiles y navegación por gamepad; L1/R1 cambia de categoría y el D-pad recorre las opciones.

releases.body:
## Historial completo desde el proyecto original

Base de comparación: [nxdevxz/p4g-android](https://github.com/nxdevxz/p4g-android), `main` en `v0.5.2-beta` (commit `2d3368f`). Esta es la primera release pública de P4GP e incluye los cambios acumulados desde esa base.

### Identidad de la aplicación
- Nombre visible **P4GP** y paquete Android `io.github.synndras.p4gp`, instalable junto a la aplicación P4G original y con sus datos separados.
- Icono, icono adaptable y arte de launcher propios de Persona 4 Golden.
- Firma P4GP consistente para instalar esta versión sobre las compilaciones P4GP anteriores.

### Launcher
- Interfaz de inicio rediseñada con estética Persona 4 Golden, fondo animado, franjas multicolor y estática CRT configurable limitada al launcher.
- Layout adaptable a orientación panorámica y vertical, con barra lateral, accesos rápidos, estado del juego y botón **¡JUGAR!**.
- Ajuste de proporciones y espaciado para evitar que los accesos rápidos queden recortados.
- Accesos rápidos para resolución, formato de pantalla, FPS, filtrado anisotrópico, FSR y exportación de registros.
- Categorías para Pantalla, Rendimiento, Controles, Archivos y **Más opciones**.

releases.body:
## 中文

本期新增 termux-ui 模块，为 Windows 应用、Linux 桌面、文件和运行组件提供统一图形界面。

- Windows 应用与游戏：通过独立的 Wine 环境导入、配置、管理和运行程序。
- Linux 桌面：创建、启动、管理和重新安装 Native 与 PRoot 桌面环境。
- 运行组件：下载和管理 Wine、Box64、图形及配套组件，支持自定义 Wine 和 Box64 版本。
- 文件管理：浏览文件、批量操作、查看文件信息，并将检测到的 Windows 程序导入程序库。
- 输入与显示：按程序配置显示设置、键盘鼠标输入、虚拟按键和游戏手柄。
- 备份与恢复：导出和恢复 PRoot 桌面容器、Wine 环境及 Wine C 盘。

## English

Introduce the new termux-ui module with a unified graphical interface for Windows applications, Linux desktops, files, and runtime components.

- Windows apps and games: import, configure, manage, and launch programs with dedicated Wine environments.
- Linux desktops: create, launch, manage, and reinstall Native and PRoot desktop environments.
- Runtime components: download and manage Wine, Box64, graphics, and supporting components, including custom Wine and Box64 builds.
- File management: browse files, perform batch operations, view file details, and import detected Windows programs.
- Input and display: configure per-program display settings, keyboard and mouse input, virtual controls, and game controllers.
- Backup and recovery: export and restore PRoot desktop containers, Wine environments, and Wine C drives.

> [!WARNING]
> **Only install official stable releases** (like this one). Do NOT install pre-releases or raw CI artifacts — pre-release builds use a different package name (`com.tencent.ig`) and cannot be upgraded to stable without uninstalling first.

> **Microphone permission required for Voice Chat.** When you activate voice chat (dashboard → Game Configs → Voice Chat), BannerHub will prompt for the **Microphone** permission. You must allow it for in-game calls to work — without it the call falls back to opening in your browser.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Files access required for SD card storage.** To save games to your SD card, BannerHub must be granted the **Files and Media** permission (Android Settings → Apps → BannerHub → Permissions → Files and media → Allow management of all files). Without it the SD card toggle has no effect.

releases.name: PocketDeck v0.6.10
releases.body:
## 更新内容

### ✨ 新功能与本地游戏库升级
- **多级子目录递归扫描**：各平台目录支持最多 3 级子目录扫描（自动跳过媒体/隐藏目录、`.nomedia` / `.pocketdeckignore` 与符号链接循环），支持跨目录 `.m3u` 与分目录多盘聚合
- **主流本地封面与元数据规范兼容**：完整兼容 `gamelist.xml`、`metadata.pegasus.txt` / `metadata.txt` 以及 Pegasus / ES-DE / Miyoo / OnionOS / RetroArch 常见本地封面目录与命名后缀
- **本地封面零主线程 I/O 与本地优先**：所有本地封面在后台扫描与目录/文件变更时预扫描并持久化至 V4 二进制缓存，滚动期间零磁盘访问；存在本地封面时默认优先显示本地图，不再重复请求远端封面（优先级：自定义封面 → 手动远端选图 → 本地封面 → 自动刮削缓存）
- **App 与 Web 手动选图支持本地图片**：手动刮削与编辑页支持在离线状态下检索并选用本地候选封面；Web 管理端同步支持浏览与选用掌机本地封面（新增 `/api/local-cover` 路径边界校验接口）

### 🎨 界面交互优化
- **连通性测试与高清大图预览**：服务连通性测试内联融合至刮削源列表，游戏详情页与手动刮削弹窗统一支持全屏高清封面大图预览浮层

### 🛠️ 兼容性与问题修复
- **模拟器启动与磁盘格式兼容**：支持自动识别 PSX2PSP PBP 标题与平台、修复 PPSSPP 大写扩展名与 Android 11+ `FileProvider` `content://` 启动兼容，默认优先 RetroArch PCSX ReARMed，并自动忽略 `.csz` 辅助文件
- **文本查看器编码自适应**：App 与 Web 文本查看器自动识别 GBK / Big5 / Shift_JIS / UTF-16 编码，解决中文与日文攻略/说明乱码
- **压缩包解压体验优化**：RAR 压缩包解压支持实时流式进度上报

releases.name: PocketDeck v0.6.9
releases.body:
## 更新内容

### ✨ 新功能与交互升级
- **默认外观焕新**：将「星海漫游」设为默认背景主题并置顶，将「悬浮磨砂岛」设为默认导航栏样式（原默认样式更名为「经典通透」作为第二选项）
- **批量刮削任务弹窗重构**：设置页点击先预览待刮削 / 缺封面 / 缺信息明细再确认开始；运行中隐藏右上角关闭按钮消除歧义，点击「终止任务」立即锁定为「正在终止…」防连点；结束态支持直达「查看日志」与「继续刮削」
- **全局弹窗键盘避让与手动搜索优化**：`DialogPanelCard` 统一支持软键盘弹起平滑上移、收起平滑复位；手动搜索刮削提示词常驻（支持触屏与 3 级手柄焦点流），新增清空与收起键盘快捷按钮
- **服务连通性测试**：在「设置 → 刮削 → 操作」新增并发服务连通性检测，一键查看各刮削源与更新服务在当前网络下的可达性与延迟

### 🛡️ 稳定性、网络容错与性能优化
- **网络可用性与离线提示**：完善 Wi-Fi / 移动网络（SIM）在线判定，为批量刮削、手动搜索、Web 网页管理及掌机快传补齐离线 / 未连局域网提示
- **刮削容错增强**：新增 `HostCircuitBreaker` 域名熔断保护、扩展 `cjk_aliases` 中文别名词库与封面回退机制
- **性能与内存优化**：优化冷启动 `offline_db` 预载与多平台并发控制，修复顶栏 60fps 空转动画，离线库 TSV 解析改用 `indexOf` 零临时列表切片（保持 11.2 MB 轻量体积）

• **立体扇形（CoverFlow）快滚流畅度大幅优化**：移除 `CoverFlowStage` 冗余参数消除快滚期双重重组，并为默认封面标题接入 2D 离屏纹理缓存（`CompositingStrategy.Offscreen`），在保留无封面卡片标题显示的同时消除 3D 透视文字光栅化卡顿。
• **手柄快捷键方案重构与底栏图标升级**：调整默认键位（`A` / 点击封面查看详情、`START` 直接启动游戏、`X` 切换收藏、`SELECT` 打开应用列表、`B` 纯返回，同步更新设置页键位说明），并将 `BottomBar` 快捷键提示替换为统一风格的矢量图标。
• **核心性能与刮削准确率优化**：完成 P0/P1 性能瓶颈治理、封面与元数据刮削准确率提升，以及多视图交互流畅度与 UI 细节规范化升级。
• **画廊与立体扇形元数据展示完善**：恢复快滚期间底部元数据实时更新，并在画廊视图（`GalleryView`）底部信息胶囊中补齐游戏类型（`genre`）展示。

releases.name: PocketDeck v0.6.7
releases.body:
## 更新内容（相对 v0.6.6）

• **Web 端 SSE 实时刮削任务管理**：通过 SSE `scrape_progress` 事件实时同步掌机端刮削进度（建连即推、状态切换即时推、运行中 250ms 节流）；合并为单一悬浮刮削任务面板，支持查看当前进度/已更新/未匹配统计、随时停止、重新刮削、最小化胶囊恢复、查看实时日志，并针对手机浏览器视口自适应全宽展示。
• **静态资源内容哈希 ETag 缓存控制**：Web 控制台 `app.js` / `style.css` / `login.js` / `login.css` 改用进程内缓存的 SHA-256 内容摘要作为 `ETag`，热更或版本升级后自动失效旧浏览器缓存。
• **后台运行与熄屏电源策略**：恢复尊重系统默认自动熄屏时间，仅在刮削任务或 Web/快传服务开启时按需保持亮屏；为 Web 服务与局域网快传接入 `ForegroundService`（含锁屏后台 `PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK` 与 `WifiLock`）。
• **新增 4 种桌面视图模式与滚动修复**：支持 `CoverFlow`（3D 透视轮播）、`Hero`（焦聚大图+胶片条）、`Arc Wheel`（弧形转盘）、`Collector Shelf`（实木收藏柜），并优化 4 种视图重组性能与 `Apps` 页面首尾行方向键滚动裁切问题。

releases.name: v0.6.6
releases.body:
## 更新内容（相对 v0.6.5）

releases.name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.6.1
releases.body:
This release adds a bundled driver for Snapdragon 8 Elite, brings back the audio presets that were missing from 0.6.0, fixes DLC imports and GPU hangs, lets each touch control be resized, and redesigns the launcher.

## Graphics

- **Adreno 8xx driver for Snapdragon 8 Elite.** A source-built Mesa 26.3 Turnip with a fix for the newer Qualcomm gralloc, which otherwise leaves the whole image garbled on Adreno 830. Auto selects it on SM8750 devices unless an imported driver is chosen, and it always renders with `TU_DEBUG=sysmem,nobin`. On Adreno 830 it measured about 12 ms of GPU time per frame at 100% resolution, compared with about 26 ms on the stock driver. Other Adreno 8xx GPUs can select it manually; it has only been validated on Adreno 830.
- **High refresh rate displays.** The game requests the display's fastest mode and passes the FPS option to Android, so FPS settings above 60 are no longer capped at 60 by vsync on 120 Hz phones.

releases.name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.6.0
releases.body:
- Fixed DLC imports after the base game is installed, including DLC-only ZIPs/folders and ZIPs left in to_install by older builds (issue #162). Packs are hash-checked in a temporary tree before replacement; previous packs can be recovered after an interrupted replacement.
- Accepted HMM JSON schemas with trailing commas, comments and a UTF-8 BOM; schema errors no longer dump the complete file (issue #93).
- Added a persisted game-storage choice for internal memory, app folders and Android/media folders on mounted volumes, including SD cards. Optional verified copying keeps the original game, mods, settings and saves (issue #90).
- Added missing translations in English, Russian, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese and Portuguese, including mod settings, updates, storage selection and localized file/installer errors.
- Fixed overlapping guest memory copies with `memmove`, addressing the ring crash and broken collision triggers (PR #158 fix by [puopg (Michael Chen)](https://github.com/puopg)).
- Removed the earlier small-block quarantine and collision repair workarounds alongside that fix (PR #158).

releases.name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.5.3
releases.body:
small update

### Vulkan driver profiles

- Added **Adreno 8xx Experimental (sysmem+flushall)** as a separate, non-default launcher choice.
- The new profile uses the bundled whitebelyash Mesa 26.2 gen8-capable driver and forces the exact `TU_DEBUG=sysmem,flushall` workaround for artifact-prone Adreno 8xx devices.

### Android audio presets

- Added an experimental **POCO F8 Ultra (low latency)** preset. It reduces the internal FIFO cushion from 16 to 8 guest audio frames (about 85 ms to 43 ms) and requests AAudio's exclusive low-latency path to avoid HyperOS selecting an approximately 80 ms shared hardware burst.
- The existing **Default** and **AYN** behavior is unchanged. The POCO-specific path is opt-in because it may crackle, stall or lose sound on devices whose AAudio/MMAP implementation is unreliable.
- The selected preset, resolved FIFO parameters, AAudio performance/sharing modes, hardware burst, active buffer and platform xrun count are written to the Android log.

releases.name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.5.2
releases.body:
### The fix for freezing and crashing on some devices (handhelds like AYN and some Android 13 phones) is still on development. We'll release it as soon as possible

Version 0.5.2 replaces the withdrawn 0.5.1 APK. It includes every user-facing change from 0.5.1, removes performance instrumentation that was unintentionally left enabled there, and adds the following.

### Mod settings (issue #75)

- Mods with an HMM `ConfigSchemaFile` now have their own settings button.
- Boolean, string, integer, floating-point and custom-enum fields are supported, including descriptions, defaults and numeric limits.
- Settings are saved atomically to the mod's INI without discarding unrelated sections, keys or comments.

### In-app updates (issue #83)

- Added periodic update checks and a manual **Check for updates** button.
- The launcher shows release notes and download progress, verifies GitHub's SHA-256 digest when present, and rejects APKs with a different package name or Android signing certificate.
- Installation is handed to Android's system installer; game files, saves, mods and settings stay in place.

### ISO / update / DLC installation (PR #78)

A customized Winlalor mali from [GunaCharanTeja](https://github.com/GunaCharanTeja) an improved console-inspired game library, downloadable graphics wrappers, and an experimental Vulkan rendering/frame-generation path.

### Highlights & Features
- Winlator Mali+ branding and an animated, responsive launcher with portrait/landscape game cards, selectable shortcuts, game cover art, and a compact per-game summary of Vulkan wrapper, FEXCore, Box64, and presets.
- Cloud-fetched and custom game cover art, with local fallback behavior when online artwork is unavailable.
- Bannerlator wrapper catalog integration: browse, download/update, checksum-verify, and select wrappers per container or shortcut; saved selections are restored and applied when launching a game.
- Vulkan host renderer settings for color order, present mode, and installed host driver, plus optional Native Rendering/low-latency scanout.
- Experimental native Win-FG frame generation and optional LSFG Native after importing and validating the user's own `Lossless.dll`; the DLL is not bundled. Compatibility depends on the Vulkan driver/device.

# XHYN V 0.3 Preview 4

## What's new

- Vulkan Drivers and DXVK show what the game last loaded and what is selected for the next launch, including driver fallback.
- Driver ZIP imports show progress, can be cancelled, and keep your current driver selected. You can now view and clear shader caches individually.
- The touch layout editor has snap-to-grid and safe-area guides. Controls has a controller test for buttons, sticks, and dead zones.
- LAN room details show the host, local or virtual connection, and build compatibility information. You can view your enabled resource mods and measure outgoing traffic from the room.

- Supported phones have an optional sustained performance mode. Graphics startup errors now identify a rejected Direct3D feature level when the log records it.

Install **XHYN-V-0.3-preview4.apk** over Preview 3 Hotfix 1 to keep your settings. Use your own compatible GTA V Legacy files. [Buy GTA V](https://store.rockstargames.com/game/buy-gta-v)

# XHYN V 0.3 Preview 2 — launcher startup fix

Preview 1 could close immediately without showing the launcher. Its rebuilt APK omitted 146 original artwork files required during application startup. Preview 2 restores those files, preserves their authentication and touch icons, and adds checks using the final signed APK's own resources.

Install **XHYN-V-0.3-Preview2.apk** over Preview 1; the app ID and release key are unchanged, and the version code is newer. There is no need to uninstall first. **XHYN V Bridge stays at 0.1.0**; an already installed copy does not need updating.

releases.body:
# Ymir v0.4.0
[Discord](https://discord.gg/NN3A7n5dzn) | [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/StrikerX3) | [Compatibility list](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SLZzL9LelSlpEmTKy8cjaQnE7mew2uW1rfCgcekO58Q/edit?usp=sharing) | [Screenshots](https://emu.layle.dev/ymir/54fead6/)

SDL Renderer has been the backbone of graphics on Ymir... until now. Ymir now supports Direct3D 12 and Metal (with Vulkan to come in the future), which will enable implementation of shaders and resolution scaling down the line. Direct3D 12 also supports hardware-accelerated VDP rendering, offloading heavy graphics computations to your GPU for a significant performance boost with no accuracy compromises -- it's as accurate as the software renderer, save for undiscovered bugs. Other graphics backends will eventually support acceleration as well, hang tight!

The Virtua Gun has been promoted to a stable feature after numerous bug fixes and accuracy improvements that made it work flawlessly with most supported games. Known issues are listed in #787: only one game doesn't register shots, and three don't recognize reloads consistently.

# Ymir v0.3.2
[Discord](https://discord.gg/NN3A7n5dzn) | [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/StrikerX3) | [Compatibility list](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SLZzL9LelSlpEmTKy8cjaQnE7mew2uW1rfCgcekO58Q/edit?usp=sharing) | [Screenshots](https://emu.layle.dev/ymir/584dcc1/)

This release brings a large set of bug fixes and accuracy improvements once again guided by @celeriyacon's test ROMs, pushing compatibility to just over 94%! A workaround for 16 games described below would bring this number to 94.6%.

The highlight of this version is the huge set of fixes to CD Block HLE, bringing more parity with the LLE counterpart and improving compatibility and stability with dozens of games. VDP1 fixes also resolved a few longstanding issues and brought some games to life.

Performance got another huge boost in multiple avenues with this version. First, thanks to @SternXD, you can now offload audio processing tasks to another CPU core, freeing up the emulator thread to focus more heavily on the SH-2s and general system logic. This alone can boost performance by up to 25% and possibly more, depending on how much work is put on the SCSP DSP.
